panel.universe: all 500 math500 test records MINUS the 200 indices frozen by the superseded exploratory six-arm run (cross_domain_math/frozen_math_tasks.json); 300 remaining
panel.selection: stratified by answer type over the remaining 300 (proportional allocation, min 1 per stratum), deterministic sha256('xmath:'+index) ascending within stratum
panel.exposure: zero overlap with any prior workspace query text (14,650 prior queries checked); no prior tuning on math500

scorer.method: LaTeX normalization (balanced braces) + sympy exact equivalence; gt parse rate 500/500; agreement with release scorer 497/500
scorer.release_disagreements: 3 cases archived in SCORER_RELEASE_DISAGREEMENTS.json; gold NEVER modified; all 3 disagreements favor this scorer (equivalent fractions, unit-omitted answer, interval notation)

nodes.prompt: restate the problem, list unknowns/conditions, give a step plan; JSON output
derive the final answer; last line \boxed{...}
nodes.deployable_failure: boxed extraction failure / sympy unparseable / non-finite evaluation

nodes.prompt: independent re-derivation or numeric cross-check of the solve answer; verdict + corrected value
nodes.deployable_failure: format check + agreement flag (consistency signal, model-based NOT deterministic)

dag.honest_boundary: math has no deterministic correctness oracle; runtime signals are validity + consistency only; correctness is decided offline vs gold by the frozen scorer; Dynamic value on math is expected weaker than on code — reported honestly

arms.always_medium: mono medium, one call, boxed answer scored by frozen scorer
arms.query_router: mono; large iff frozen panel median token guard exceeded else medium
arms.node_type_router: analyze(large)->solve(medium)->verify(coder), one call per node, NO recovery; final = verify-corrected value if consistent else solve value
arms.static_dag: same DAG + deployable failure detection + local fallbacks (analyze->medium, solve->coder, verify->medium) with descendant closure refresh
arms.dynamic_real: same DAG; deployable detection only; memory-based model switches on failure (first failure->coder, later->medium in task order); solve/verify escalate to large; budget-gated (budget = 1.2 x static realized, B_rem<200 skip+record); selective refresh only

collection.gpu_discipline: engine guard refuses while GPU busy
collection.expected_calls: ~700-1,000 with shared node cache across arms

rq.RQ1_stage_complementarity: node-level Oracle vs best fixed model per node type
rq.RQ3_feedback_dynamic: dynamic_real vs static_dag on Q with cost/budget reported

superseded_exploratory.verdict: exploratory/superseded, NOT a paper table source: universe restricted to 398 numeric-normalizable tasks (102 symbolic tasks excluded though our scorer parses 500/500) and its normalizer rejects correct symbolic answers
